## Install

Unity **6000.0.85f2** or later. No package dependencies — optional packages and built-in modules each turn on a group of
feedbacks (see the README's Requirements).

*Window > Package Manager > + > Add package from git URL...*

```
https://github.com/xpTURN/Feedback.git?path=/com.xpturn.feedback#__TAG__
```

Or in `Packages/manifest.json`:

```json
"com.xpturn.feedback": "https://github.com/xpTURN/Feedback.git?path=/com.xpturn.feedback#__TAG__"
```

[README](https://github.com/xpTURN/Feedback/blob/__TAG__/README.md) · [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/xpTURN/Feedback/blob/__TAG__/com.xpturn.feedback/CHANGELOG.md)
